learning_outcomes.text: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.

Ability to conduct bibliographic searches, consult and critically use databases and other sources of information, to carry out simulation and analysis with the aim of conducting research on technical topics in their specialty.
Ability to consult and apply codes of good practice and safety in their specialty.
Ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, problems and solutions in the field of engineering and with society in general.
Ability to function effectively in national and international contexts, individually and in teams, and to cooperate with engineers as well as with people from other disciplines.
Ability to stay updated on new developments in science and technology.
Knows and applies knowledge of quality management to different systems in the healthcare field.
Knows and understands the peculiarities regarding regulations and certifications of medical devices.
Applies knowledge of certifications and regulations when designing medical devices for their subsequent commercialization.
Ability to manage specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.

Students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds upon general secondary education, and is typically at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes aspects implying knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

Students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences that are usually demonstrated by the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their area of study.
Students have developed those learning skills necessary to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy.

syllabus_topics: Economic operators: manufacturers, importers, distributors, authorized representatives, and notified bodies
Product commercialization process in the EU
EC (EU) Declaration of Conformity and CE marking
teaching_methods: Professor's presentation in the classroom in participatory classes (concepts and procedures)
Tutoring and monitoring sessions for training activities

assessment_methods.method: Individual written and oral tests for the evaluation of technical competencies of the subject
Reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation practices, and laboratory practices

assessment_rules: Individual written and oral tests are recoverable for the sections where they constitute 75% and 100% of the grade for RAB11. There are no recovery mechanisms for reports on exercises, case studies, computer practices, simulation, and laboratory practices. For the assessment related to RAB12, there are no recovery mechanisms.
